Name: (AT) Hardwood Paths
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
S'exactly what it says on the tin, a bunch of the paths recolored to have a hardwood-esq theme for some warmer paths in a color you don't really get in the game as of present. 

[b][u]The paths that are recolored:[/u][/b]
Brick Floor
Crystal Floor
Rustic Plank Floor
Stone Floor (two variations)
Weathered Floor
Wood Floor
Wood Path

Use the paint bucket tool w/Alternative Textures to apply the new textures, you can also use the paint brush to paint multiple tiles with the same copies texture.

[b]If you like the stuff I make, consider sending me a [/b][b][url=https://ko-fi.com/lilydoesthingssometimes]ko-fi[/url]﻿ - never required of course, I do this stuff for fun, but it does make it easier to focus on making things.[/b]
